Many indie games mostly are unfinished games that have one broken level design combined with questionable story. Only a few of them I truly enjoyed that I put them in a special place in my heart. Katana ZERO joined that little group.

Satisfying gameplay is the key of good games, this game has it. Even though it only takes around 3-4 hours to finish, you can feel the passion and effort they put into every level in the game. It's very polished and well-designed that could put those triple A games nowadays to shame.

Those pixel graphics and the soundtrack are *kisses* top notch. The combination of neo-noir visual artstyle and the music really made the atmosphere feel more lively, moody and soothing at the same time. The apartment sequences are my favourite parts in the game. It makes you thinking about your life for a moment and how little things can be enjoyable things.

The dialogue sequence has a big part in the game. Your actions or dialogue choices can have you a different ending but not very significant. However, the story from narrative conversation is the main dish. The writings are well-written that keep you to play again, to see what happens next. Although there is no voice actor, you can still feel the vibe or tension in the dialogue sequences.

The best game in 2019 so far, at least for me. Looking forward to the sequel.

Katana ZERO does not fail to make my eyes widen. The story is a roller coaster of emotions, the art is insanely beautiful, and the audio just adds so much to the game--the whole reason why I began playing was because of the catchy, cyberpunk-like soundtracks this game has to offer. Each element of Katana ZERO link so well with each other, it makes the playing experience ethereal. This game is truly worth every penny.

It has been years since I've been tempted to finish a game to its completion and Katana Zero stopped that trend right in its tracks. The story telling is absolutely phenomenal and it isn't even completed yet. The gameplay is absolutely addicting and makes me keep coming back to play it again and again. Right now I'm on a track to try and get all of the achievements and I'm only 2 away from the finish line. Please play this game it'll be nothing like you've ever experienced before.

Twenty-eight years in that godforsaken jungle.
Killing soldiers wasn't so bad. I hardly remember it.
But burning those villages , watching those naked peasants cry...
I see it every day. It's not PTSD , it's the drug.
It's only been a week , but it feels like a year.
Every word is getting longer , the mosquitoes are getting louder.
When the drug runs out , time stops , and you're stuck in the jungle forever.
It's... grains of sand in a shrinking hour glass.
I know what comes next. I need to ask you a favor.

Never in my life I left a review on a Steam game, and I've been on this platform for... Hell, 7 to 8 years?

This game is a MASTERPIECE.

Not unlike the kinds of Hotline Miami, Hollow Knight, Hyper Light Drifter or King's Bird.
Hell, I'd might even say it's better than all of those, but I'll write that off as my personal opinion.

Hours of fluid and plain fun but challenging gameplay, gorgeous retro graphics and INCREDIBLE soundtrack, all nestled in one of the more gripping scripts, world and characters I've experienced in the last couple YEARS. All that accomplished in less than six hours. Hell, that might be my only complaint: Sure as f*ck leaves you wanting more.

This WILL become a cult-classic, mark my words.
If not, it sure as hell should.
